jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York City · Hybrid · 3 days/week in office
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare implementation and operations fit: state launches, payer implementations, partnerships and high-impact cross-functional projects closely match workflow design, onboarding, systems/process improvement and healthcare operations experience.
jobs.gap: The role favors consulting-style structured problem solving and high-growth startup experience. Emphasize project ownership, workflow automation and healthcare operations without overstating consulting background.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare project-management match leading hospital specialty-pharmacy launches across clinical, operations, IT and executive stakeholders, with project plans, workflow redesign and system implementation responsibilities.
jobs.gap: Travel is substantial at about 50%, and the work is hospital/specialty-pharmacy focused. Position healthcare operations, training and systems implementation experience clearly while being honest about limited hospital deployment depth.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid · 3 days/week in office
jobs.why: Strong fit for requirements gathering, implementation planning, onboarding, testing, client communication and cross-functional delivery across pharmacy and medical-benefit implementations.
jobs.gap: PBM and health-benefit implementation experience is specialized. Highlight healthcare workflows, UAT/testing, documentation and stakeholder coordination without implying deep PBM expertise.

jobs.title: CX Ops Manager
jobs.why: Excellent operations-builder role focused on scalable customer workflows, SOPs, onboarding, knowledge systems and cross-functional execution in healthcare, matching process design, training and operational systems experience.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 4–6 years specifically in CX, customer success or service operations. Frame healthcare family/staff interactions and operations ownership as transferable without overstating formal CX tenure.

jobs.title: Enterprise Insurance Operations Lead
jobs.location: New York, NY · On-site / hybrid flexibility
jobs.why: Behavioral-health technology plus insurance operations is highly relevant to healthcare intake, payer workflows, process improvement, automation and cross-functional operations experience.
jobs.gap: The role is more deeply focused on insurance and enterprise payer operations than current experience. Emphasize authorization/intake workflow knowledge and systems thinking while being clear that payer-domain depth is still developing.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York City · In-office with occasional remote flexibility
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS implementation role combining project plans, stakeholder communication, workflow requirements, training, documentation and coordination with Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: The role expects deeper enterprise SaaS implementation and technical integration fluency. Emphasize workflow implementation and systems ownership without overstating API or architecture expertise.

jobs.title: Field Integration Specialist
jobs.location: New York · Field-based / regular onsite customer presence
jobs.why: Strong match for hands-on healthcare training, workflow troubleshooting, implementation support and translating operational processes into practical guidance for clinical and administrative teams.
jobs.gap: Oncology, radiology and medical-billing experience are preferred, and the role is heavily field-based. Position ABA healthcare training and workflow support as transferable rather than claiming specialty-clinic expertise.

jobs.title: Clinical Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare operations and strategy role in a fast-growing specialty-pharmacy company, with strong overlap in process building, cross-functional execution and clinical-operations support.
jobs.gap: Specialty-pharmacy and benefits strategy are more specialized than current ABA operations experience. Treat as a calculated stretch and lead with healthcare systems, training and process-improvement ownership.
